header.productTitle: SuperMouth Orthodontic Toothpaste: Advanced care for Braces & Aligners
header.shortDesc: Protect teeth, prevent cavities, and reduce decalcification with SuperMouth’s patented orthodontic toothpaste for braces and aligners. Orthodontist-formulated with fluoride, nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2, prebiotics, and safe, clean ingredients, it remineralizes enamel, neutralizes acids, reduces sensitivity, and supports a healthy oral microbiome. Delicious flavors—chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, and mint—ideal for kids, teens, and adults.
header.superHtml:
SuperMouth sets a new standard in orthodontic oral care with our patented orthodontic toothpaste, specifically formulated for those undergoing orthodontic treatment. Whether you have braces, aligners like Invisalign, or other orthodontic appliances, our toothpaste ensures your mouth remains clean, protected, and healthy.

Our proprietary Hydroxamin+ complex, powered by Liquid Enamel Technology™, addresses the unique challenges of orthodontic treatment, notably increased risks of cavities and decalcification—unsightly white or yellow marks that can form around braces or aligners. Featuring more than 10% nano-hydroxyapatite that is naturally compatible with your tooth structure, along with fluoride, vitamins D3 & K2, this specialized formula strengthens enamel, reduces sensitivity, and supports enamel remineralization.

  • Clinically Proven Protection: Designed specifically for optimal dental health during orthodontic care.
  • Orthodontist-Developed: Expertly crafted by specialists in orthodontic treatment.
  • Liquid Enamel Technology™ (Hydroxamin+ Complex): Proprietary blend of more than 10% nano-hydroxyapatite, fluoride, vitamins D3 & K2 to strengthen enamel, reduce sensitivity, and protect against decalcification.
  • Xylitol-Enriched: Supports moisture retention and promotes a balanced oral environment.
  • Microbiome-Friendly: Free from harsh essential oils, alcohol, and antiseptics, preserving your oral microbiome’s natural balance.
  • Low Abrasivity: Relative Dentin Abrasivity (RDA) of 67 ensures effective cleaning without damaging enamel.
  • pH-Balanced Formula: Helps maintain natural oral equilibrium for lasting freshness.
  • 100% Clean Ingredients: Free from artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, antibiotics; non-GMO.
  • Prebiotic Support: Includes inulin and other prebiotics to nurture a healthy oral microbiome.
  • Made in the USA: Crafted with premium, globally sourced ingredients.
  • Inclusive and Responsible: Gluten-free and paraben-free to appeal broadly and uphold environmental responsibility.

Choosing SuperMouth Orthodontic Toothpaste is an investment in the health, beauty, and longevity of your smile during and after orthodontic treatment.

left.title: The SuperMouth Toothpaste Difference
left.text: SuperMouth toothpastes feature flavors like Super Mint, crafted to be delicious and refreshing without the burning sensation typically associated with other mint brands. We use light foaming agents to avoid harsh irritants and skip titanium dioxide, a chemical often used to make toothpaste appear white but with potential risks. The result? A safe, effective, and healthy clean every time.

left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.

FAQs
items.html:
Why is orthodontic-specific toothpaste recommended during braces treatment?
Orthodontic treatments, including braces and aligners, necessitate specialized oral care to prevent common issues such as cavities and white spots. SuperMouth’s Orthodontic Toothpaste is engineered to clean around complex orthodontic appliances effectively, safeguarding against dental problems associated with braces.
How does the Hydroxamin+ formula in orthodontic toothpaste protect teeth with braces?
The Hydroxamin+ formula in our orthodontic toothpaste is specially enriched with an elevated concentration of nano-hydroxyapatite, surpassing the minimum 10% found in our other varieties, along with vital nutrients like vitamins K2 and D3. Together with fluoride and other key ingredients, this potent mix is engineered to significantly strengthen enamel and prevent decay, providing comprehensive protection for those with braces or other orthodontic devices.
Is SuperMouth’s toothpaste for braces safe for children and teens in orthodontic care?
Yes, SuperMouth Orthodontic Toothpaste is meticulously formulated with children and teens in mind, providing a safe, gentle, and effective solution for young individuals undergoing orthodontic treatment. Its clean, non-toxic ingredients make it ideal for maintaining youthful smiles.
Why does SuperMouth’s formula for braces avoid essential oils and prioritize oral microbiome health?
Recognizing the critical role of the oral microbiome in overall dental health, our orthodontic toothpaste is crafted without essential oils to prevent disruption of this delicate ecosystem. This approach ensures comprehensive protection and nurturance of oral flora, vital for individuals with braces.
What ensures the safety and efficacy of SuperMouth Orthodontic Toothpaste as per the EWG safety scale?
SuperMouth Orthodontic Toothpaste proudly adheres to the highest safety standards, with all ingredients (excluding fluoride for dental health) rated ‘1’ on the EWG safety scale. This commitment to safety and efficacy makes our toothpaste a trusted choice for braces wearers seeking reliable oral care solutions.
What other orthodontic-specific products should patients consider during braces treatment?
At SuperMouth, we understand the comprehensive needs of orthodontic care, which is why we offer a full line of orthodontist-designed products tailored for braces wearers. Our Orthodontic Systems include the innovative OrthoBrush, OrthoFloss, and Ortho-formulated Mouthwash, along with additional aids like our mouth sprays and tongue scrapers. These products are available individually or as part of a system, with options for one-time purchases or convenient subscriptions, ensuring you never run out of essential supplies during your treatment.

reviews.name: Stephanie
reviews.title: Dental hygienist’s praise!
reviews.body:
I’ve always hated the taste of mint.  So although I brush my teeth daily, doing so has always been a yucky and unpleasant, royal PITA for me.  I would often struggle with tarter buildup because I wouldn’t brush throughly enough.  I also love sweets and I’m prone to cavities.  Using a fluoride toothpaste and/or rinse is a necessity for me.  
Since I discovered and switched to SuperMouth Ortho Toothpaste, Fluoride mouthwash, and Floss (chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry flavors) my dental hygienist is constantly amazed at the little amount of tarter buildup I have nowadays, and she raves about my white and bright smile.  I tell my hygienist every time that I swear by SuperMouth’s Ortho Care line of products.  I’ve also been cavity free for the first time in my life!

Thank you Super Mouth!  I hope you never stop making the Ortho line of products.  I would be so sad!
